integrity: The mathematical proof gives the infinite-order criterion; the standalone code provides independently constructed finite cross-checks, not independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers exactly two letters, one fixed full cycle and one arbitrary transition map. Its closed enumeration is restricted to semiprime orders. Finite exhaustive verification reaches n=6 and is not the proof for general n; mathematical novelty is subject to unindexed prior work.
title: Modular subgroup hierarchy for unrestricted adversarial synchronization of cyclic automata
